input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 is the operative grant for the Services and sits in walk-away territory: it is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, non-transferable, and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them. Sections 13.2 (perpetual, irrevocable Affiliate/contractor licence) and 13.3 (transfer to Affiliate or successor; revocation only for material uncured breach after notice and cure) meet the preferred position, but 13.2 is limited to paid-up or embedded software and Vendor Technology and does not cover the hosted Services, so the fallback is not met for the Services licence and the two clauses directly contradict each other. The redline conforms 13.1 to the language already agreed in 13.2 and 13.3 by extending the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, deleting discretionary revocation, and cross-referencing the 13.3 transfer and revocation limits.

proposal.summary: Extend the §13.1 grant to Affiliates and contractors, remove revocation at Vendor's discretion, and permit successor transfer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, removed revocation at Vendor's sole discretion, and confirmed transferability to an Affiliate or successor, consistent with our playbook position and with Sections 13.2 and 13.3 as drafted. As a fallback we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice and successor transfer limited to an M&A transaction.

ops.oldText: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf, a licence to use the Services for Customer's and its Affiliates' business purposes. The licence is transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3 and is revocable or suspendable only as expressly permitted by Section 13.3.
